# Planview Portfolios - product overview (Avantra summary)

> Demonstration content summarised by Avantra from publicly available Planview positioning. Pending curator verification against the official product page and datasheet. Contains no pricing.

## Overview

Strategic portfolio management (SPM) solution for connecting strategy, funding, resources and delivery across the enterprise.

Also known as: Portfolios, Planview Enterprise One, Enterprise One. Solution areas: Strategic Portfolio Management, Project Portfolio Management. Deployment: SaaS.

## Capabilities

- **Portfolio management** - a core capability of Planview Portfolios: Prioritise, select and balance investments/projects across the portfolio.
- **Strategic planning** - a core capability of Planview Portfolios: Translate strategy into funded initiatives; scenario and what-if planning.
- **Resource management** - a core capability of Planview Portfolios: Plan, allocate and manage people and roles across work.
- **Capacity planning** - a core capability of Planview Portfolios: Compare demand with capacity by role/skill over time.
- **Financial management** - a core capability of Planview Portfolios: Budgets, forecasts, actuals and cost/benefit tracking for work and portfolios.
- **Project governance** - a core capability of Planview Portfolios: Lifecycle stage-gates, approvals, compliance and governance controls.
- **Demand management** - a core capability of Planview Portfolios: Capture, evaluate and route new work requests (intake).
- **Reporting & analytics** - a core capability of Planview Portfolios: Dashboards and analytics across portfolios and work.
- **Project management** - a supported capability of Planview Portfolios: Plan and execute projects: schedules, tasks, milestones, dependencies. Note: Project scheduling is supported; collaborative task execution is often paired with a work-management product.
- **Time tracking** - a supported capability of Planview Portfolios: Capture time/actuals against work.
- **Product roadmapping** - a supported capability of Planview Portfolios: Build and communicate product and strategic roadmaps. Note: Strategic/portfolio roadmaps.
- **Agile planning at scale** - available via integration of Planview Portfolios: Plan and coordinate agile teams and teams-of-teams; connect agile delivery to portfolio. Note: Agile delivery is typically connected via Planview AgilePlace and/or Planview Hub.
- **Toolchain integration** - available via integration of Planview Portfolios: Synchronise work items across delivery tools (e.g. Jira, Azure DevOps, ServiceNow). Note: Via Planview Hub or integration services.

## Implementation considerations

- Agree the portfolio hierarchy, lifecycle stage-gates and financial planning model before configuration.
- Resource master data quality (roles, skills, availability) is the main driver of capacity-planning value.
- Plan ERP/finance integration for actuals early if financial management is in scope.
- Typical enterprise roll-outs are phased (PMO/portfolio first, then resource and financial management).
